header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Dispatch Individuals and Groups to Give Da'wah

blocks.text: The Sahabah (RA) Dispatch Individuals and Groups to Give Da'wah
Hadhrat Hishaam bin Al Aas (RA) and others are sent to Heraclius

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Hishaam bin Al Aas Umawi (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Hishaam bin Al Aas Umawi (RA) narrates that (during the Khilaafah of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)) he and another person were sent with the invitation to Islaam to Heraclius the Emperor of Rome. He says that when they arrived at Ghowtha meaning Damascus, they went to see Jabala bin Ayham Ghassaani who happened to be lying on his bed at the time. He sent a messenger to speak to them. When the messenger came, the Sahabah (RA) said, "By Allaah! We shall never speak to a messenger for we have been sent to see the king. If he grants permission, we shall speak to him but not to a messenger." When the messenger returned to the king with the news, he permitted them to enter and to speak. Hadhrat Hishaam bin Al Aas (RA) spoke to him and invited him to accept Islaam.

The king was wearing black clothing. When Hadhrat Hishaam bin Al Aas (RA) asked him why he was dressed in that manner, he replied, "I have vowed never to remove this clothing until I expel you from Shaam." The Sahabah (RA) said to him, "By Allaah! We shall soon be taking from you this place where you sit and we shall also be taking the kingdom of your high emperor (Heraclius), Inshaa Allaah! Our Rasul Muhammad ﷺ has informed us of this." The king said, "You are not those people. They will be people who fast during the day and stand in worship during the night." The narration continues further and will Inshaa Allaah be quoted in the chapter dealing with the help received from the unseen.[^1]

Hadhrat Moosa bin Uqba narrates that Hadhrat Hishaam bin Al Aas (RA), Hadhrat Nu'aym bin Abdillaah (RA) and another person whom the narrator did name were sent to the Emperor of Rome during the Khilaafah of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). Hadhrat Hishaam (RA) says, "We came to Jabala bin Ayham who was in Damascus and noticed that he was wearing black and that everything around him was black. He said, 'You may speak, O Hishaam.'" Hadhrat Hishaam (RA) then spoke to him and invited him towards Allaah. The Hadith proceeds in detail as will be quoted ahead.[^2]
